strongest_angle: Analyze why Aaron Sorkin's Facebook follow-up, The Social Reckoning, failed with a $5.5 million opening weekend from Sony, contrasting it with Universal's horror hit Other Mommy starring Jessica Chastain, which topped the box office with $27.5 million.

key_facts.fact: Sony released director Aaron Sorkin's Facebook-focused feature The Social Reckoning, which opened significantly below forecasts with a dismal $5.5 million opening weekend.
Universal's horror movie Other Mommy, starring Jessica Chastain, easily secured the number one spot at the box office with a $27.5 million debut during the same weekend.
Aaron Sorkin previously wrote The Social Network, directed by David Fincher, for which Sorkin won the Academy Award for best adapted screenplay.
The Social Reckoning managed to bring in $2.1 million on Friday, including Thursday preview screenings, before finishing its low opening weekend.
